name: Innocent Mbele
intro:
Hello, I’m Innocent. Welcome to my portfolio!

I’m passionate about technology, infrastructure and finding practical ways to solve problems. My interests span telecommunications, networking, cloud computing, Linux, cybersecurity and web technologies. I enjoy exploring how things work, experimenting with new technologies and putting ideas into practice.

This portfolio brings together projects and technical experiments I’ve undertaken to expand my skills, explore new technologies and showcase what I can do. You’ll find practical implementations, screenshots, testing evidence and source code, giving you a closer look at my work and how I approach different challenges.

Feel free to explore!
footer: The projects on this site come from my personal GitHub repositories. I practised and compiled them for my own skills development.
